newsitem.title: USA: Travelers seeks to enter Calif. auto market.
newsitem.headline: Travelers seeks to enter Calif. auto market.

text.p: Travelers Property Casualty Corp said it has filed an application with the California Insurance Department to enter the state's individual automobile insurance market.

Under terms of the application, Travelers said it will set up two wholly-owned subsidiaries -- TravCal Indemnity and TravCal Secure -- in Rancho Cordova, Calif., to write auto business in the state beginning September 1.

TravCal Indemnity said it will write auto business through Travelers Property Casualty's 225 licensed independent agents in California and TravCal Secure will write business through approximately 900 Secure (Primerica Financial Services) agents, also licensed in the state.

"We believe we can grow this business in California and look forward to bringing Travelers competitive auto products into the state," said Daniel Hurtado, president and chief executive officer of TravCal.
Initially, TravCal will write only individual auto policies.
Travelers homeowners business in California, currently serving more than 75,000 customers, will also move to TravCal beginning in January 1999, Hurtado said.
California is the fourth state in which a single-state company focusing on personal lines business has been formed by Travelers, the company said.
The others are First Floridian, developed last year in Florida, First Trenton in New Jersey and Premier in Massachusetts.
